verdict.rationale: First-party Gemini in BigQuery docs say users can find, join, and query table assets and visualize results in natural language, hold natural-language conversations with their data through conversational analytics, start analysis with natural-language queries, and have SQL/Python generated or explained. Release notes add market-basket questions to conversational analytics. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language accuracy, and evidence that natural language covers administrative operations (dataset creation, loading, IAM) beyond analytics and querying.
